known.via: English Wikipedia "Sierra de Salamanca" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A Castile and León DO in Salamanca province, known for red wines from the native Rufete grape. It ranks between vino de la tierra and DO. Garnacha Tinta and Tempranillo are also allowed, along with Macabeo and Palomino for white.
